scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: Albuquerque school-zone roadway flashers; owner-supplied IPRA timing sheets
scope_assessment.specific_material_albuquerque_connection: Named Albuquerque schools, local intersections and addresses with concrete activation times
scope_assessment.public_information_value: Lets readers inspect when school-zone flashers are scheduled and distinguish shared locations and controller exceptions
scope_assessment.exclusion_test: This is local operational public data with 61 concrete intervals, not general school context or transactional IPRA paperwork
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: Roadway safety and the operation of Albuquerque public infrastructure are core ABQInfo subjects; direct timing lookup gives useful information beyond the originating websites per owner provenance.

quality_assessment.visual_inspection: All 33 rendered pages reviewed in full; interval/weekday rows and notes checked against text
quality_assessment.standalone_public_value: Complete supplied local timing dataset with maps, locations, controller counts and update notes
quality_assessment.information_density: Sparse individual sheets form a substantive 30-schedule family; publish as one dataset/source, not 30 document entries
quality_assessment.series_component_relationships: Pages 10 and 28 are the same shared-school schedule; 11 and 29 contain only a small map fragment; preserve all original bytes
quality_assessment.intended_publication_form: One direct readable alphabetical list with intervals, locations, weekday gaps and important qualifiers, plus unchanged full PDF provenance
quality_assessment.currentness: No issuing agency/current designation/global effective period; retain as supplied IPRA record and qualify currentness explicitly
quality_assessment.limited_content_exception: Not needed for the complete 33-page source. No separate short-sheet publication proposed.
quality_assessment.substantive_rationale: The exact dataset is independently useful for local school-zone public information, and direct transcription removes the need to inspect 33 pages while preserving the complete original.

privacy_findings: Professional staff names/initials and metadata author appear; no student identities, private contacts, personal identifiers, IPRA requester details or credentials found. Street maps, aerials and flasher/controller illustrations are operational public context. No redaction needed; unchanged original retained.
agency_finding: No agency logo, letterhead, issuing department or response cover letter in the PDF. Do not infer City/APS authorship from owner IPRA provenance.

date_findings.latest_explicit_operational_note: School flashers turned on 7/31/26 (Mission Achievement and Success Charter)
date_findings.interpretation: The title date and print metadata are not an effective date; individual sheet revisions are evidence of recorded changes only.

unresolved_publication_blocker: Exact R2 archival authorization, followed by original public-byte verification; elementary continuation is not a blocker
